decisions.rule: Represent Japanese SBIC as three separate regional sister companies (Tokyo/East, Osaka/West, Nagoya/Central) until the original referent is resolved.
decisions.rationale: Each official company profile identifies a separate legal entity and names the others as sister companies.

decisions.rule: Classify ChatGPT mentions in SBIC East/West materials as education/seminars, not OpenAI partnership or XRP commercial relationship.
decisions.rationale: Official event materials show training content only.

decisions.rule: Keep Social Bias Inference Corpus separate from the Japanese investment-development companies.
decisions.rationale: Peer-reviewed NLP literature uses SBIC for a dataset.

decisions.rule: Do not compile or attribute YouTube videos to a Camilla Stephenson until a channel identity is verified.
decisions.rationale: Exact-name searches returned no channel; same-name professional profiles are not linked.

decisions.rule: Keep 'actual capital' source context unresolved and distinguish market cap, gross volume, net external capital and executed XRP purchases.
decisions.rationale: Exact search did not identify a unique originating XRP source.
